offers_products.reason: Manufactures mowers, snowplows, underground construction equipment, irrigation and lighting products under Toro, Exmark, Ditch Witch brands.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from equipment sold through dealers; services such as financing or support are incidental.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Homeowners buy Toro residential mowers, snow blowers and yardcare products through retailers and dealers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Golf courses, landscape contractors, rental companies, government and schools buy turf and underground construction equipment.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly equipment purchases made periodically by customers, not subscriptions or consumable repeat orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Mowers, construction equipment and residential products are deferrable; contractors and homeowners cut purchases in downturns and housing slowdowns.

big_ticket.reason: Commercial mowers, trenchers and horizontal drills are costly, infrequent equipment purchases; residential mowers are also occasional.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured equipment, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are homeowners, golf courses, small landscape contractors and dealers rather than large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufacturer with plants, but sells through dealers and distributors; not heavy-asset in the utility or fleet sense.

notes: Asset-heavy is a borderline call, since it runs manufacturing plants.
